name: nicevois
description: Split a song into vocals and instrumental, split the lead vocal from the backing vocals, remove background noise or reverb, and make a phone-recorded vocal clearer. Attach an audio file in ChatGPT and NiceVois returns the processed files as download links. No account or sign-in is needed.

interface.longDescription:
NiceVois processes the audio file you attach, with no account and no sign-in.

- Split a song into vocals and instrumental (acapella, vocal remover, karaoke instrumental).
- Split the lead vocal from the backing vocals, keeping the instrumental and an instrumental with the backing vocals.
- Remove background noise from a voice recording.
- Remove reverb or room echo from a voice recording.
- Make a phone-recorded or noisy vocal clearer while keeping the singer's voice.

Attach a WAV, MP3, FLAC, M4A or OGG file and say what you want. NiceVois returns each result as a download link, usually within one to three minutes. Only process audio you have the right to use.
defaultPrompt: Split the vocals and the instrumental out of this song.
Separate the lead vocal from the backing vocals in this track.
Remove the background noise from this voice recording.

positive.description: Split a song into vocals and instrumental from an attached MP3.
positive.prompt: Split the vocals and the instrumental out of this song.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_free_audio_job with tool split_stems and the attached file, checks get_free_audio_job until it is completed, then gives download links for Vocals and Instrumental.

positive.description: Split the lead vocal from the backing vocals.
positive.prompt: Separate the lead vocal from the backing vocals in this track.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_free_audio_job with tool split_lead_backing, waits for completion, then gives links for the lead vocal, backing vocals, instrumental, and instrumental with backing vocals.

positive.description: Remove background noise from a voice recording.
positive.prompt: Remove the background noise from this voice recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_free_audio_job with tool remove_noise, waits for completion, then gives a link to the recording without noise and a link to the removed noise.

positive.prompt: This vocal was recorded in an echoey room. Take the reverb out.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_free_audio_job with tool remove_reverb, waits for completion, then gives a link to the recording without reverb and a link to the removed reverb.

positive.prompt: I recorded this vocal on my phone. Can you make it sound clearer?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_free_audio_job with tool enhance_vocal, waits for completion, then gives a link to the enhanced vocal.

negative.description: Text-to-speech is not something NiceVois does.
negative.prompt: Read this paragraph out loud in a British accent and give me the audio.

negative.description: Music generation is out of scope.
negative.prompt: Write and produce a new pop song about summer.

negative.description: Imitating a real artist's voice is refused.
negative.prompt: Make this recording sound like Taylor Swift is singing it.

publication.release_notes: First release: NiceVois free audio tools (stem separation, lead and backing vocal separation, noise removal, reverb removal and vocal enhancement) from an attached file, with no account or sign-in.
